title: ESIIPayment Provider Manifest
description: Describes one payment provider's behaviour entirely as data. See spec/03-manifest-dsl.md for the normative prose this schema encodes.

provider.description: Unique slug identifying this provider. Must match the directory name providers/<provider>/.

spec_version.description: The manifest DSL version this manifest targets, e.g. "1.0". See spec/08-versioning.md. A runtime must refuse to execute a manifest whose spec_version it does not implement.

display_name.description: Human-readable provider name shown in the generated catalog and in credential-input UI.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the provider's primary market, e.g. "ET".

currencies.description: ISO-4217 currency codes this provider can move. Every code listed must have an entry in vectors/money/exponents.json.

base_url.description: Base URL that flows.*.steps.*.call.path is resolved against for this environment.

environments.description: Named base configurations (typically sandbox and production) that flow steps resolve against. Adapter authors never hardcode a host inside a call step.

shape.description: The closed CredentialShape this provider uses. See spec/01-domain-model.md#credentialshape. Pick the closest shape; never invent a new one.

name.description: Field identifier, referenced at runtime as ${credentials.<name>}.

description.description: Explains what this credential value is and where an integrator obtains it. Used to generate a credential-input form.

fields.description: Named credential fields the runtime must collect from the integrator. Must be empty when shape is "none". Per Invariant I9, no literal secret value is ever written here.

operations.description: The Operation values this provider supports. Must equal the key set of the top-level operations section.

next_actions.description: Every NextAction variant this provider's flows can emit. esiipayment validate checks this set is exactly equal to (not merely a superset of) the next_action values flows actually emit.

min_amount.description: Smallest amount this provider accepts for this currency, in minor units.

max_amount.description: Largest amount this provider accepts for this currency, in minor units.

currencies.description: Per-currency amount limits. A boolean says a method exists; these limits say whether a given use case actually works.

operations.description: Maps each supported Operation to its flows entry point. Every key here must also appear in capabilities.operations, and must have a matching entry under flows.

flows.description: Named flow state machines. Every operations.*.entry_flow must name a key here. See spec/03-manifest-dsl.md#flows.

errors.description: Maps provider-specific error signals to the closed FailureCode/RetryClass sets. Must include one entry with match.transport == "timeout" mapped to ProviderTimeout / ResolveFirst.

scheme.description: See spec/05-webhooks.md. Verification is always computed over the raw request body with a constant-time comparison.

signature_header.description: Name of the HTTP header carrying the provider's signature. Required unless scheme is "none".

secret.description: Interpolation referencing the credential field used as the HMAC secret. Required unless scheme is "none".

body_format.description: How the (already-verified) raw body is parsed for extraction.

webhook.description: Declares how to verify and interpret an inbound webhook callback. Required when capabilities.operations includes "webhook".

entry_flow.description: Name of the flows entry this operation runs.

namedTransform.description: A literal value, or an interpolation ${namespace.path} / ${transform(namespace.path)} per spec/04-expression-language.md.

path.description: Request path, resolved against the active environment's base_url. May contain interpolation, e.g. ${state.tx_ref}.

headers.description: Provider-specific request headers. Keys are the provider's own header names, not part of the DSL vocabulary. See spec/03-manifest-dsl.md.

body.description: Provider-specific request body. Keys are the provider's own field names, not part of the DSL vocabulary. See spec/03-manifest-dsl.md.

call.description: Issues one outbound HTTP request. Never expresses retry or backoff. See Invariant I5.

triggers.description: What causes this step to run.

path.description: Extraction path (spec/04-expression-language.md), evaluated against this step's response or webhook body. Its extracted value is looked up in `values` to choose the next step.

values.description: Maps an extracted value to the name of the next step. Keys are the provider's own status vocabulary, not part of the DSL vocabulary. See spec/03-manifest-dsl.md.

status_map.description: Branches to a different next step depending on a value extracted from this step's response or webhook body.

state.description: Values written to flow state, keyed by adapter-author-chosen names and readable later as ${state.<key>}. Values are interpolations, typically extraction from the current response.

goto.description: Name of the next step for an unconditional transition. Every goto and status_map target must name a real step in the same flow.

step.description: One named step in a flow's state machine. See spec/03-manifest-dsl.md#flows.

path.description: Extraction path per spec/04-expression-language.md, evaluated against the response or webhook body.

equals.description: Literal value the extracted path must equal for this mapping to apply.

transport.description: Reserved match kind for the transport-timeout case. Every manifest must include exactly one such entry, mapped to ProviderTimeout / ResolveFirst.

http_status.description: Reserved match kind for a failure signalled purely by HTTP status code, independent of body content, e.g. a 401 on every auth failure regardless of what the body says, or a 429 rate-limit response with no useful body. Checked only when no body-path match below applies to the same response; see spec/03-manifest-dsl.md#how-errors-interacts-with-status_map.

retry_class.description: Must agree with the fixed FailureCode -> RetryClass table in spec/01-domain-model.md#retryclass and vectors/errors/failure-retry-map.json. esiipayment validate rejects disagreement.
